module.name: Host Healthcheck
module.description: This is a description for the module.

inputs.label: Host Name or IP
inputs.description: Host name or IP address to perform health check on.

inputs.label: Host Port
inputs.description: Port number to perform health check on.

inputs.label: Host use SSL (1=True, 0=False)
inputs.description: Indicates whether to use SSL for the health check (1=True, 0=False).

inputs.label: Host Path
inputs.description: Path to execute a HTTP request and check if the host is reachable.

inputs.label: HTTP Request Parameters
inputs.description: Parameters to include in the HTTP request {} or {'key1': 10, 'key2': 'value2'} format.

inputs.label: Healthcheck Benchmark
inputs.description: Benchmark value for the health check on the http(S).

inputs.label: Healthcheck Frequency
inputs.description: Frequency of the health check in seconds.

inputs.label: Enable Logging
inputs.description: Enable diagnostic Syslog messages and debugging (1=True, 0=False). Errors and critical messages are always logged.

outputs.label: HTTP Health
outputs.description: Indicates whether the HTTP health check succeeds (1=True, 0=False).

outputs.label: Response Time
outputs.description: Response time of the Ping health check in milliseconds.

outputs.label: Health Check Error
outputs.description: Error message for the most recent HTTP health check, or empty when successful.

timers.description: The seconds interval for performing periodic host health checks.
